Logic Goat - Logic Gate Simulation

Posted on August 15, 2024

This post is showcase of a project I have made on python using the pygame library. The project is called ‘Logic Goat’ and allows users to create logic circuits and test them.

How to use:

  • Gates can be added from the side bar or using the numbers 1-9
  • Gates can be deleted by clicking on them then pressing backspace
  • Gates connected through dragging the mouse between connection nodes
  • Connections removed through right clicking connection node
  • File saved using the button on sidebar

These examples can be found in the examples folder:

  • Full adder (shown below)
  • Half adder
  • SR Flip Flop
  • Multiplexer 2x1

This project can be found on my github on this link: https://github.com/MSaidAlizada/LogicGateSim
